SlipstreamIntegration.reason: Compiled at 1,000 optimizer runs (its own compilation_restrictions entry in foundry.toml, the clvault profile), because at 10,000 runs it was 24,436 bytes (140 under EIP-170) and the CL-01 to CL-03 fixes would have put it 22 bytes over (audit/reviews/cl-lpvaults, CL-05). Measured with script/check-sizes.sh on the default profile on 2026-11-12: 23,019 bytes, 1,557 under EIP-170, so it meets the default 1,024-byte margin with 533 bytes to spare and the entry keeps that margin. The Slipstream integration carries the four NPM and factory generations as immutables; a change that grows it past the margin must split code out, not lower the margin.
